description: Parse a KiCad .kicad_pcb layout to extract copper layers, board outline, SMD/THT pads, routed segments, arcs, and vias. Call first before DFM audits or cloud routing. Accepts raw pcb_text or local project_path; falls back to built-in 2l_rp2040 if omitted. Returns JSON layer, pad, and track counts. Example: project_path='board.kicad_pcb'.

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 KiCad .kicad_pcb S-expression text for remote calls.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a .kicad_pcb file (STDIO mode).

name: analyze_kicad_pcb
title: Analyze KiCad PCB Layout
